title: Processing of Special Categories of Personal Data (Genetic Data, Biometric Data, and Data Concerning Health)

clauses.mandate: Processing of genetic data, biometric data for the purpose of uniquely identifying a natural person, data concerning health shall be prohibited unless specific derogations apply.
security_measures: Cryptographic isolation of genetic sequences from demographic identifiers
Dedicated Customer Managed Key (CMK) envelopes for DNA repositories
Zero unencrypted data transmission across perimeter boundaries

clauses.mandate: The controller and the processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures including pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data.
security_measures: Default server-side encryption with AES-256 or AWS KMS
Immutable versioning for continuous data integrity verification
